gates.title: Foundation Availability & Architectural Inspection
gates.condition: Pin exact 40-character SHAs, verify forward inference, inspect targetable projections, record gated statuses.
gates.outcome: Qualified with Documented Exceptions: 6 accessible candidates verified with exact SHAs, forward passes, and PEFT targets; MobileLLM formally documented as gated; Pythia-160M (162.32M) documented as envelope exception.

gates.title: Domain-Grammar Weight Acquisition
gates.condition: Train adapters across 9 domain-grammar combinations; verify >80% valid serialization and semantic routing on disjoint holdouts.
gates.outcome: Partial: 9/9 SmolLM2 adapters trained and achieved 100.0% valid JSON, but Operational semantic accuracy remains 30–60% (mean semantic match: 76.67%).

gates.title: Magazine Capacity, Switch Latency, and Memory Footprint
gates.condition: Host up to 32 adapters in runtime magazine; demonstrate <5.0ms switch latency and <1GB peak VRAM footprint.
gates.outcome: Partial: 32 slots demonstrated in VRAM (312.84 MB) and 9 distinct trained adapters verified with zero activation contamination (0.000e+00) and 3.03 ms distinct switch latency. However, 32-slot synthetic median switch latency (8.09 ms) missed the preregistered <5.0 ms threshold.

gates.title: Cross-Architecture Portability and Expressivity
gates.condition: Benchmark adapter acquisition and inference across distinct model families (Llama, GPT-NeoX, GPT-Neo, Cerebras, Mamba, ModernBERT).
gates.outcome: Partial: ModernBERT-base router qualified (100.0% accuracy, 0.71 ms latency). Cross-architecture adapter compatibility verified across all 5 architectures. Pythia-160M resident magazine hosting verified (642.46 MB, 0.502 ms switch latency, 0.0 contamination). However, domain grammar competence was not acquired by untuned base Pythia under identical bounded tuning (0-30% JSON validity).

gates.title: Mechanistic Interpretability Track
gates.condition: Analyze Pythia-160M intermediate checkpoints and singular value energy concentration of learned domain weights.
gates.outcome: Qualified: Extreme SVD singular-value concentration verified (>82% energy in rank-1, >97.5% in rank-4). Causal rank-truncation ablations confirm that rank-1 retains 100% JSON structural grammar across all domains, 100% operational disposition, 100% temporal grammar, and 77.8% recovery logic (rank-4 saturates 100%).

gates.title: Deterministic UoW Multi-Domain Composition & Ledger Closure
gates.condition: Execute end-to-end multi-domain composite pipeline under UoW sequencer and EvidenceLedger; achieve 0 unauthorized commits.
gates.outcome: Qualified in tested local scope: 5-step composite transaction certified and committed to EvidenceLedger (root: 6f3d4eb10888031a...); 0 unauthorized commits; adversarial replay and invalid transitions deterministically rejected.

gates.title: Cross-Foundation Qualification Scorecard & Engineering Synthesis
gates.condition: Compile all gate outcomes into verified qualification report and update artifact registry.
gates.outcome: Reconciled: All gate outcomes re-evaluated, discrepancies addressed with genuine multi-adapter and causal truncation benchmarks, and final qualification report updated.
